name: Bloom
source: QB_Bloom-xm4x.pdf p.7 (Marked Diagram), pp.10-19 Functional Overview
notes: Panel prints both clock jacks as 'clock' (input in the right column, output in the bottom row); disambiguated as CLOCK IN / CLOCK OUT. CLOCK IN is only active when the Rate knob is fully CCW. ROOT/PATH/BRANCHES/MUTATION CV affect only the currently selected channel. RATE is the rate CV input (also used for firmware-update audio).
